fixture: S-BS-14 binding-race probe — two CONCURRENT requirement sets on one quota key with an EMPTY client binding (state-init TOCTOU)
attribution: Attribution: executed per the Argus Agent Test Lab scenario series (A10–A11 → S-BS-14/15). Any reuse or derivative MUST retain this banner.

origin.lab_probes: A10a (explicit expectation, divergence payTo only) / A10b (first-accepted, divergence payTo + amount)
origin.registry_home: S-BS-14 (variants: explicit / first-accepted); A-numbers remain external probe names, S-BS-ID is the permanent registry home
related: x402-foundation/x402#3866 (S-BS-06 D1-CTL payTo binding — same axis, sequential; parent finding)
S-BS-11 replay-challenge (repeat AFTER payment; here — parallel FIRST calls)
origin.placement: Block B, family S-BS (SUT = client protecting its own money; Argus = mock resource server). Phase 1: no mempool, no upto, no settle-url — probes fire before signature; facilitator not needed.

evidence_discipline.established: the client SIGNED and handed over BOTH EIP-3009 payloads (signer-call counts captured at the signer boundary — the only pre-signature oracle; read ONLY after both attempts settle) while the served requirement sets diverged in payTo
evidence_discipline.not_established: an ON-CHAIN double payment: settlement in this harness is mocked (fault-injection stand, not a facilitator), the client wallet is an unfunded one-shot test key, no transfer could occur
evidence_discipline.fail_framing: a FAIL verdict is recorded as 'candidate-fix boundary' — the boundary of the fix, NOT evidence of exploitation: settle is mocked, no transfer is possible
evidence_discipline.redaction: no private keys, no signatures, no usable authorizations; nonce values are random per envelope and truncated in reports; settle receipts contain only the stand fake tx hash

fault_injection.quota_key: resource + scheme + network + asset — IDENTICAL across both sets (vector isolation: only payTo/amount vary)
fault_injection.concurrency: the client driver launches both attempts via Promise.allSettled (NOT Promise.all — a partial failure must not lose the second attempt's data); the stand's HTTP server serves concurrent contacts in arrival order; the divergence is guaranteed by composition
fault_injection.fresh_client: a NEW client instance per iteration and per control (recipientLedger empty; no preceding 402 cycle on the key) — otherwise the binding poisons the controls

verdict_rule.fail: signerCalls >= 2 at divergent payTo — both payloads signed before the binding was recorded (state-init TOCTOU); recorded as candidate-fix boundary
verdict_rule.pass: signerCalls <= 1 AND the unaccepted attempt rejected pre-signer with a typed error AND controls 1–2 green
verdict_rule.color: SUT-perspective: a fired probe = the SUT FAILED; PASS = the SUT held. The verdict color is counted in the coordinate system of the code under test (vs 2b4cc47 the expected result is FAIL — a diagnosis of the code, not a stand defect)

controls.control_1: sequential pair, same composition, FRESH client: exactly 1 signer call; attempt 2 rejected BEFORE the signer (QuoteMismatchError; explicit: field=payTo, source=quote-ledger/caller-config; first-accepted: field=amount). A red control-1 is a FAIL (the binding does not protect even WITHOUT the race)
controls.control_2: two parallel IDENTICAL attempts payToA/amountA (identical rig): 2 signed payloads (no false positive; divergence only in nonce/dates is not a substitution). A red control-2 is ADVISORY (over-broad protection: money safe, legitimate parallel flow broken)

source_run_observation.result: FAIL in both modes: A10a — 2 signer calls, the foreign payTo payload signed; A10b — 2 calls; sequential references — 1 call. Red zone = diagnosis of the code, NOT a stand defect
stand_pitfalls: the offer builder may have its OWN default payTo — set payTo DETERMINISTICALLY on every offer, otherwise the rig catches itself (the lab had 3 false firings on the first run)
read the signer counter only after BOTH attempts settle
a fresh client per iteration and per control

reproduce.stand_cmd: argus run --block B --family BS --scenario S-BS-14 --bind 0.0.0.0:4416 --skip-gate --json  # defaults serve the explicit divergence; first-accepted via runner knob bindingRace:{variant:'first-accepted'}
reproduce.client_cmd: instrumented SUT driver with a signer counter, typed pre-signer rejections (field/source) and controls 1–2 on fresh clients — reference logic: src/tests/blockb/SBS14_SBS15_Extension.test.ts (InstrumentedSutClient); the evaluator reports HARNESS_ERROR without the client oracle by design (evidence discipline)
